form.notes: Form-associated: submits `name=value` (a string, empty when none), resets to the `value` attribute, restores on navigation and joins <fieldset disabled>. `required` is a constraint (valueMissing).

differences.text: The value is a string (encode structured values yourself, for example as JSON); it is uncontrolled with the `value` attribute as its default and native `input`/`change` events when the content commits a different value. Upstream is a controlled generic `Value` with `onChange`.

The `children` render prop `(value, onChange, close, state)` is the default slot plus methods: the content calls `commit(value)` (upstream `onChange`) and `hide()` (upstream `close`) on the element, and reads `value`, `open` and `loading` from it. `handleRef` becomes the element itself (`show`, `hide`, `toggle`, `requestClose`, `focus`).

`triggerLabel` is the `trigger-label` attribute or slot and `startIcon` the `start-icon` attribute or `start` slot; `onOpenChange` is the cancelable `tct-open-change` intent event (user-driven changes and `requestClose()`) plus `tct-after-open-change`; `contentXstyle` is the `content` part.

The popover is a `role="dialog"` named by the label with focus moved into it, Tab kept inside (a focus trap) and returned to the trigger on close; ArrowDown on the trigger opens it. The content owns its own inner semantics.
The `is*` props are bare boolean attributes and `xstyle`/`data-testid` are replaced by class, style, `::part()` and host attributes.
The trigger is the shared Tecton outlined field (or the tertiary action fill for `ghost`); the popover is a 1px rule on the recessed popover fill with no drop shadow (D-013).

core.complex-selector.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] the dialog popover and focus trap; [mwg:animate-to-from-top-layer] the popover enter and exit; [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements] value, validity, reset and restore. The popover is a dialog popover (kind popover with a focus trap), not an adaptive sheet: the content owns its layout.
